title: Generalize Cad Model Definitions
description: Remove concrete model-definition IDs from core/kernel/renderer by introducing cad module system with runtime composition root.
summary: Removed concrete model-definition IDs from @semio-tech/cad-js-core and @semio-tech/cad-js-kernel-brepjs by introducing a flow-style module system: generic registries (registerPropertyComputer, registerImportProfile, additive registerModelDefinitionAssets), four domain modules (spatial-shape, aec-building, aec-building-energy, aec-building-structure), and @semio-tech/cad-js-runtime composition root (asset glob + bootstrapCadModules). Play host bootstraps runtime; transformation scoring and structure derivation generalized. Fixed lazy interaction catalog loading and relative asset path resolution. Tests: runtime, all modules, kernel (40), query (42), stately (4), renderer library (63), play build green. Core retains 362/396 passing; 34 interaction e2e/registry tests still fail (pre-existing interaction completion harness issues).
